h: Shabbos Repairs Both Destructions Through Truth and Peace

p: that of Toras Kohanim and that of Mishneh Torah.
For it is stated (Zohar Chadash, Tavo)
that the rebukes of Toras Kohanim
correspond to the destruction of the First Temple,
to the destruction of the Second Temple.
and the Second Temple was destroyed
Torah she'bichsav and Torah she'b'al peh:
for in the time of the First Temple
the conduct of the world was
from the side of Torah she'bichsav,
and then there was the flow of prophecy,
which are the words of Hashem Yisbarach
of the words of HaKadosh Baruch Hu Himself,
there was a surge of heresy,
and this was a matter evil toward Heaven,
but they were not evil toward people,
only of the leaders of Yisrael
is it written, "in order to shed blood" (Yechezkel 22:6).
they were not evil toward people.
"I alone remain a prophet of Hashem" (Melachim I 18:22),
and did not reveal it to the king
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּמִּדְרָשׁ, וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה כו, ב)
(as they said in the Midrash, Vayikra Rabbah 26:2);
that Ovadiah had hidden a hundred prophets,
and although they did not believe in the prophecy,
and did not want him to kill them all.
And the destruction of the Second Temple
was abolished by the Men of the Great Assembly
and only because of the baseless hatred
for in the time of the Second Temple
there were the very greatest tzaddikim,
of the spread of Torah she'b'al peh,
for there were the Men of the Great Assembly,
and all the decrees and fences
of which it is not known who instituted them
without specification, the Men of the Great Assembly
as it says in Seder Olam:
and hear the words of the wise.'"
of the spread of Torah she'b'al peh
there was, as one opposite the other, the surge
"'When they speak with enemies in the gate'
what is 'enemies in the gate,' etc.?
Even a father and son, etc.,
who are occupied with Torah in one gate
become enemies of one another, etc."
they said, "They do not move from there
עַד שֶׁנַּעֲשׂוּ אוֹהֲבִים זֶה אֶת זֶה
until they become loving to one another,
For when they arrived at the clarification of the halachah,
And it is stated in the Midrash
(בְּמִדְרַשׁ רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה יט, בְּמִדְבַּר רַבָּה יט, ב)
would go out to war and be victorious,
because there were no informers among them;
would go out to war and fall,
because there were informers among them.
the children in the days of David
knew how to expound the Torah
You will preserve him from this generation
And it appears that this derashah is
from the first part of the verse (Tehillim 12:7):
from the expression "From the mouths of babes, etc."
because David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
was a chariot for the middah of Malchus
פֶּה תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה קָרֵינַן לָהּ
the mouth, we call it Torah she'b'al peh
and he was the main root
and they said (Midrash Rabbah, beginning of Parshas Acharei):
And this is as Rebbi said
is because I saw Rabbi Meir from behind;
had I seen him from the front,
a root of Torah she'b'al peh;
וּכְמוֹ כֵן בְּדָוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and likewise David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
a root of Torah she'b'al peh,
and whoever saw him was reminded of his learning;
and therefore in his time there was,
And this is the meaning of Chazal's saying
Moshe said from the mouth of the Almighty,
For the rebukes of Toras Kohanim,
which correspond to the destruction of the First Temple,
were therefore said from the mouth of the Almighty;
which correspond to the Second Temple,
the beginning of Torah she'b'al peh
Now, the rebukes of Toras Kohanim
and those of Mishneh Torah in the singular.
are not a matter of punishment,
reward and punishment are not stated;
שֶׁמּוֹרֶה עַל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא בְּעַצְמוֹ
that refers to HaKadosh Baruch Hu Himself:
and likewise in the rebukes of Mishneh Torah
everything is written with the Name Havayah;
and HaKadosh Baruch Hu does not
And also, how can there apply
is better than all the life of this world"?
And in truth there is a reason
why reward and punishment were not written
out of love of the blessings
and out of fear of the curses,
and their heart is not toward Heaven"
(according to the reading of Rashi, of blessed memory).
how is it possible to write
when their heart would not be toward Heaven?
to His service, may His Name be blessed:
if "you will walk in My statutes,"
by way of the good things of this world;
by way of the rebukes and sufferings
as David HaMelech, peace be upon him, said
"and Your staff" is the good things;
they lead me to the good and straight path.
to guide him to the good path.
And this is what they said (Megillah 31b):
that we do not interrupt during the curses?
For He is like a father
who raises the rod over him to chastise him,
and at once his son returns
and he no longer needs to chastise him.
Therefore the rebukes of Toras Kohanim,
is the One who knows the hidden things
and the thoughts of the heart
how far his heart turns away
and how far he must be chastised
to bring him back to the recognition of
the glory of His Godliness, may His Name be blessed.
For not all hearts are alike,
nor in the acceptance of the rebukes;
therefore they are stated in the plural.
And the rebukes of Mishneh Torah,
is to remove envy from the heart
and the hatred of one man for his fellow,
and to be in love, brotherhood and peace,
as one man with one heart
in what they said in the Midrash
"Truth said, Let him not be created, etc.;
Peace said, Let him not be created, etc.;
He cast Truth to the ground,
which was said from the mouth of the Almighty,
"Only falsehood did our fathers inherit, etc.";
and immorality too is called falsehood,
"Bread of falsehood is sweet to a man";
and it is also called "bread of deceit" (Mishlei 23:3).
that they become loving to one another;
and the Torah is also called truth,
וְזֶהוּ נֶגֶד יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
And this corresponds to Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
who is the falsehood in the world,
(רֵישׁ פָּרָשַׁת תּוֹלְדוֹת, בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה סג, ח)
that I created in My world";
and he is also a hater of peace
Rather, he hates a person's blood
while it is in his body."
And on Shabbos is the rectification
are on the level of truth
is afraid to lie on Shabbos;
and also on Shabbos there is
the spreading of the shelter of peace;
the Torah was given to Yisrael on Shabbos;
and also the flow of Torah she'b'al peh,

paragraphs.text: Source: Tehillim 85:12 — “אמת מארץ תצמח וצדק משמים נשקף” — “Truth springs up from the earth;justice looks down from heaven.”

rich.text: — “Truth springs up from the earth;justice looks down from heaven.”

paragraphs.text: Source: Yirmiyahu 10:10 — “ויהוה אלהים אמת הוא אלהים חיים ומלך עולם מקצפו תרעש הארץ ולא יכלו גוים זעמו” — “But the ETERNAL is truly God—A living God, The everlasting Sovereign. At God’s wrath, the earth quakes, And nations cannot endure such rage.”

paragraphs.text: Source: Yirmiyahu 16:19 — “יהוה עזי ומעזי ומנוסי ביום צרה אליך גוים יבאו מאפסי ארץ ויאמרו אך שקר נחלו אבותינו הבל ואין בם מועיל” — “O ETERNAL One, my strength and my stronghold, My refuge in a day of trouble, To You nations shall come From the ends of the earth and say: Our ancestors inherited utter delusions, Things that are futile and worthless.”
